adjudication.cross_relation_generality: the train-selected global site has positive mean candidate_raw adjusted gain in at least three of four relations on both validation and test
adjudication.emergence_timing: descriptive only: signed site distance and fraction at-or-before emergence; it cannot rescue a failed held-out gain gate
adjudication.global_operator: at the train-selected global site, lower 95% bounds for carrier, candidate_raw and candidate_zscore adjusted gain are all above zero on validation and test
adjudication.relation_routing: at the four train-selected relation sites, the pooled relation-specific test lower 95% bounds for all three adjusted gains are above zero

claim_boundary: observational convergence-operator localization; not causal attribution, not proof of a graph edge, and not authorization for attention-head semantics

interpretation_contract.attention_selected: prioritizes HEAD decomposition but does not itself identify a head
interpretation_contract.candidate_only: semantic readout convergence without demonstrated carrier alignment
interpretation_contract.carrier_only: geometric alignment without demonstrated semantic convergence
interpretation_contract.ffn_selected: prioritizes FFN write-family analysis but does not identify a feature edge

measurements.adjusted_gain: same-fact gain minus matched-control gain; positive means excess convergence

candidate_raw.similarity: negative mean pairwise Jensen-Shannon divergence over the 126-token restricted softmax

candidate_zscore.gain: z-score JS before minus z-score JS after
candidate_zscore.similarity: negative mean pairwise JS after independently z-scoring each state's 126 logits

carrier.similarity: mean of the three pairwise carrier cosines in a same-fact prompt triplet

measurements.control: the three frozen same-split, same-relation, same-prompt-family, different-subject-and-target rows already bound by GW-SUP-1
measurements.emergence_relation: selected-site order minus the edge's median sealed emergence-site order
measurements.operator_class: attention or FFN from the immutable site universe

question: which observed writes make same-fact prompt trajectories more alike than frozen relation-matched controls?

selection.global_site: site with maximum train mean adjusted candidate_raw gain across all 85 edges; earliest site wins an exact tie
selection.relation_sites: within each relation, site with maximum train mean adjusted candidate_raw gain; earliest exact tie

states.after: sealed carrier-after artifact, followed by the recorded layer_scale when present
states.before: sealed carrier-before artifact at the observed write
states.candidate_before_readout: new read-only selected-row pass over sealed before carriers
states.candidate_vocabulary: the unchanged frozen GW-SUP-1 126-token decoder vocabulary

statistics.interval: 10000-sample percentile cluster bootstrap over semantic edges
site_profile_descriptives: positive adjusted-gain mass captured by top 1, 2, 4 and 8 sites
Herfindahl and effective-site count over positive adjusted gain
